def blocks(G, div=8):
    H=len(G); W=len(G[0])
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if all(c==div for c in G[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if all(G[i][j]==div for i in range(H))]
    def segs(idx, n):
        s=[]; st=0
        for i in idx+[n]: s.append(list(range(st,i))); st=i+1
        return s
    return segs(rows,H), segs(cols,W)

def shapes(G, color):
    (R,C)=blocks(G)
    out={}
    for bi,rr in enumerate(R):
        for bj,cc in enumerate(C):
            px=[(i-rr[0],j-cc[0]) for i in rr for j in cc if G[i][j]==color]
            if px: out[(bi,bj)]=px
    return out

def crop(px):
    mr=min(p[0] for p in px); mc=min(p[1] for p in px)
    h=max(p[0] for p in px)-mr+1; w=max(p[1] for p in px)-mc+1
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in px: g[r-mr][c-mc]=1
    return g
